name: protoc-gen-connect-go

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Go Connect-RPC protoc plugin used by packages/proto service codegen (local plugin, no BSR fetch)
installHint: Installed via `go install connectrpc.com/connect/cmd/protoc-gen-connect-go@v1.19.2` (requires Go on PATH; binary lands in $GOBIN or $HOME/go/bin which Vrooli's setup symlinks into ~/.local/bin)
notes: Pinned alongside buf.gen.yaml; bump in lockstep with the proto-codegen byte-stability gate (`make check`).
